## Upload packages and read in data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(tmap)

# read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# filter to a state you are interested in
colorado <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CO") 

# filter to a county you are interested in
denver <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Denver County"))

# find the average values for all variables within counties
colorado_counties <- aggregate(colorado, by = list(colorado$CNTY_NAME), FUN = mean)
```

- Create two maps that comunicate with an environmental justice issue
- Write a brief paragraph explaining what the maps communicate

All maps must include the following elements:
- an informative title
- legends with legible titles, including units
- indication of scale and orientation (i.e. graticules/gridlines or scale bar and compass)
- color scales that are accessible (i.e. make intuitive sense) and appropriate to the data (i.e. discrete vs. continuous)

## Map 1: PM 2.5 Levels in Denver County
```{r}
tm_shape(denver) +
    tm_polygons(
      fill = "PM25",
      fill.scale= tm_scale(values = c("green", "orange")),
      fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "PM 2.5 Levels in Denver County (𝝁𝐠/𝐦𝟑)"),
      size.legend = tm_legend(orientation = "portrait"),
      position = tm_pos_out("right") +
      tm_scalebar() +
      tm_compass())
```
